Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Creative Solutions Agency specializes in developing innovative advertising campaigns for a diverse range of clients. Our operations encompass strategic brand development, creative content creation, digital marketing, and media buying. We prioritize client collaboration and ensure that all marketing materials undergo rigorous review and approval processes to maintain brand integrity and compliance with industry standards. Additionally, we implement robust cybersecurity measures to safeguard client data and intellectual property. Our team is dedicated to delivering effective marketing solutions while minimizing potential risks associated with advertising practices.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, the agency received a cease-and-desist order due to an inadvertent trademark infringement in an advertisement, leading to a legal claim with damages estimated at $75,000. The status of this loss is currently pending as negotiations are ongoing. Additionally, on June 20, 2023, a cyberattack was identified that compromised client data, resulting in reputational damage and an estimated financial loss of $150,000 to affected clients. This incident is still under investigation and has not yet been resolved.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• An agency produces an advertisement containing a tagline that unintentionally infringes on
a competitor’s trademark, resulting in a cease-and-desist order and subsequent lawsuit for
damages.
• A cyberattack compromises the agency’s cloud storage, exposing confidential client marketing
strategies and causing reputational harm and financial loss to clients.
• An employee embezzles client funds earmarked for media buys, leading to a claim under crime
insurance.
• An agency fails to obtain client approval on final ad content, resulting in the release of
inaccurate product claims and a subsequent client lawsuit for professional negligence.
